svg.text: State machines: KYC, wallet and card
Three small machines that gate what a student can do. Limits come from the KYC tier; frozen states block money movement everywhere.
Wallet FROZEN freezes all cards. KYC REJECTED never lowers an already approved tier without admin action. Card ACTIVE requires KYC APPROVED.
Part 10 · System diagrams · Mulungushi University, Zambia
